workflow.title: Inspect allocated folder space before choosing a Mac cleanup method
workflow.intent: Use PureMac Space Explorer to separate a folder-size inspection from a later destructive workflow; understand sample size versus recoverable space.
outline: Inspect the selected folder and access limits
Allocated bytes are not promised free-space gains
Choose the specific removal workflow, not a blanket Trash assumption
Decide whether manual inspection or recurring investigation fits
workflow.interaction: A non-mutating decision checklist: inspect only / app or duplicate removal / category cleanup / scheduled cleanup. Show method, confirmation and permanent-deletion caveats; no fake scanner or predicted savings.

comparison.intent: Concise product choice, not a second expanded workflow essay.
rows: scheduled cleanup versus saved exact approvals

puremac: Free MIT native toolkit with documented uninstaller, duplicate review and configuration audit; do not claim Breathing Room implements equivalent tools.
Vendor-disclosed signed/notarized stable release, unlike Breathing Room preview disclosures; not our binary audit.
Local scans documented offline; category/scheduled cleanup may permanently delete and unattended scheduling needs deliberate selection.
breathingRoom: Source-evidenced activity history and hosted investigation may suit recurring questions; PureMac absence not established.
Saved exact approvals constrain daily care; optional interactive Ruff automatic Trash exception must remain explicit.
Preview, Python prerequisite, incomplete native QA and non-notarized distribution are material costs; hosted AI requires authentication/internet and optional paid AI Care.
